description: Owner-only. Clear a stale review flag on one completed milestone whose payout is recorded, transferred and provider-verified. Only the flag changes; no money moves and an audit record is kept. Refuses pending approvals, open refunds and OpenTrain-owned funding reviews. When the automatic close is enabled and the contract is eligible, a closing contract then closes by itself if nothing else is open (result contractAutoClose). Requires explicit confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required explicit confirmation that this live contract mutation is intentional.

name: opentrain_clear_contract_milestone_review_flag
